style.styleTitle: Charles Bentley Prelit Twig 4ft Christmas Tree In Pot With 400 Twinkling LEDS
style.toneOfVoice: Our 4ft Pre-Lit White Twig Tree in Pot brings a minimal elegance to the festive season – its slender white branches catching the soft twinkle of 400 LED lights in a display that’s contemporary, calm and quietly stunning. Whether you’re working with a smaller space or simply love a more refined, design-led Christmas look, this twig tree makes an unforgettable statement. Displayed in its own neat, weighted pot, it’s ready to place and plug in – no stand required. The 400 pre-fitted LED lights are a continuous lit string, meaning a single loose bulb won’t affect the rest of the display, and the gentle twinkling effect gives the whole tree a look that’s especially magical after dark. At 4ft tall, it’s ideal for hallways and other floor areas, adding festive warmth to any corner of the home. Ideal for: Floor areas, bedrooms, home offices, and contemporary or minimalist Christmas interiors. 400 TWINKLING STAY-LIT LEDS: Pre-fitted with 400 twinkling LEDs – one loose or missing bulb won’t affect the rest of the display. Simply plug in for an instant magical glow. SCULPTURAL WHITE TWIG DESIGN: Slender white branches with a natural twig-inspired silhouette create a minimal, design-led alternative to the traditional Christmas tree – elegant and contemporary. COMES IN ITS OWN POT: No stand or separate base required – place it, plug it in, and it’s ready to display. Ideal for hallways, entryways, and floor spaces. FUSS-FREE PRE-LIT SETUP: No additional lights required. Pliable branches shape easily to your preferred look. Plug-in power source, CE certified for UK and EU use. PLEASE NOTE: For indoor use only. Keep away from heat sources and open flame. Height: 4ft (122cm). Assembly required. Dimensions(mm): Height: 1220. Width: 600. Depth: 600.
